jobs.title: Data analyst (H/F)
jobs.description:
Role Overview
The Data Analyst (H/F) is responsible for transforming complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that support strategic planning and operational improvement. This role involves gathering data from various sources, performing detailed analyses, and presenting findings to stakeholders across the organization. The Data Analyst ensures data accuracy, builds reporting tools, and contributes to the development of data-driven solutions. This position is ideal for analytical professionals who enjoy problem-solving, critical thinking, and working with diverse teams.
Key Responsibilities
• Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple systems and databases to ensure high-quality datasets.
• Perform exploratory and advanced analyses to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for optimization.
• Design and maintain dashboards, automated reports, and visualization tools for internal teams.
• Collaborate with departments such as marketing, operations, finance, and product to understand analytical needs.
• Support performance tracking by monitoring KPIs and providing regular updates.
• Translate complex analytical results into clear, understandable insights for decision-makers.
• Assist in the development of forecasting models and analytical methodologies.
• Document data processes, standards, and definitions to strengthen data governance.
• Conduct quality checks on datasets and recommend improvements for data integrity.
• Stay informed about emerging tools, techniques, and best practices in analytics.
Qualifications and Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related discipline.
• 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role.
• Proficiency with analytical tools such as SQL, Excel, Python, or R.
• Experience working with visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent tools.
• Strong understanding of analytical methods, statistical concepts, and data modeling.
• High attention to detail with strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
• Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills for cross-functional teamwork.
• Proactive mindset with a desire to learn, improve processes, and contribute to data-driven culture.
Summary
The Data Analyst (H/F) plays a vital role in enabling informed decision-making across the organization. By analyzing data, developing meaningful insights, and collaborating with key stakeholders, this role supports growth, efficiency, and strategic direction. It is well-suited for analytical and detail-oriented professionals committed to delivering accurate and impactful insights.

jobs.title: Archaeological Field Technician – Pacific Northwest (On-Call)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Tetra Tech is adding On-Call Archaeological Field Technicians
to support cultural resource projects throughout the Pacific Northwest. This is an hourly position with work assignments based on project needs and workload demands.

Selected candidates will support a variety of archaeological investigations including monitoring, survey, testing, excavation, and data recovery efforts under the supervision of Field Directors and Principal Investigators. This position offers opportunities to work on diverse projects throughout Oregon, Washington, and Idaho while gaining valuable Cultural Resources Management (CRM) experience.

Location:
Oregon, Washington, and Idaho

Why Tetra Tech

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges.Our industry-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world.For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability.Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development.Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Your Impact

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference.Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

Your Role

Archaeological Fieldwork

Conduct archaeological surveys, monitoring, testing, excavation, and data recovery activities.
Record archaeological resources using state-specific site forms and digital data collection methods.
Complete post-field documentation and site form preparation.
Collect GPS data using Trimble units, ArcGIS Field Maps, Arc Collector, and related technologies.
Capture and manage digital photography documentation of cultural resources.
Assist with mapping and documentation of archaeological resources in the field.
Support field crews in implementing project-specific survey methodologies and data collection protocols.

Data Collection & Documentation

Maintain accurate field notes and records.
Complete cultural resource documentation and reporting requirements in a timely manner.
Assist with preparation of field forms, maps, and supporting documentation.
Utilize tablets, GPS units, GIS applications, and other digital field tools.

Team Collaboration & Safety

Work effectively as part of a field crew under the direction of Field Directors and Principal Investigators.
Follow project-specific health and safety requirements.
Operate company vehicles safely and responsibly.
Maintain professional conduct while interacting with team members, clients, landowners, and agency representatives.
Conduct activities in line with internal procedures, legislation, and industry standards.
Pursue continuous professional development and maintain a high degree of discipline knowledge and awareness.
Work in a safe manner at all times and report all health and safety incidents and concerns.
Additional duties as required.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Anthropology, Archaeology, or a closely related field.
Completion of an accredited archaeological field school.
1–2 years of archaeological field experience preferred.
Cultural Resources Management (CRM) experience preferred.
Experience with archaeological survey, testing, excavation, monitoring, and related field methodologies in the Pacific Northwest.
Experience using ArcGIS Field Maps, tablets, GPS equipment, and Microsoft Office applications.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Strong written communication and editing skills.
Ability to complete cultural resource forms and documentation accurately and efficiently.
Ability to travel throughout the Pacific Northwest for extended field assignments.
Valid driver's license and ability to safely operate four-wheel-drive vehicles on rugged terrain.
Current First Aid certification or ability to obtain.
Ability to travel approximately 25–50% as required.
Must possess a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record without restrictions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience identifying prehistoric and historic archaeological resources.
Experience identifying flora, fauna, and human remains.
Experience with Trimble GPS equipment and digital data collection platforms.
Previous experience working on federal, state, utility, energy, transportation, or infrastructure projects.
Experience working in remote field environments.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

Ability to perform bending, kneeling, standing, and lifting/carrying objects weighing 35 pounds or more.
Ability to hike up to 10 miles per day carrying field equipment.
Ability to work long hours in remote locations and rugged terrain.
Ability to perform manual labor, including excavation using shovels and hand tools.
Ability to work in varying weather conditions, including extreme temperatures and inclement weather.
Ability to travel throughout Oregon, Washington, and Idaho for project assignments.
Availability to work extended field rotations, which may include assignments lasting 10–12 days at a time.
Frequent overnight travel and field-based work in remote locations may be required.

Life At Tetra Tech

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits.
Medical benefits, workers compensation insurance, and 401(k) plan.
Merit-based financial rewards.
Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance.
Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

A pre-employment drug screen in compliance with federal regulations is required, along with a physical if needed.

Compensation

Pay commensurate based on qualifications, experience, and assigned project responsibilities.

Pay Range: $25.00 – $36.00 hourly

Pay Range
- There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience and demonstrated work experience in the above role; skills, certifications, and competencies that align to the specified role; geographic location; and education, as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position.

At Tetra Tech, health and safety play a vital role in our success. Tetra Tech’s employees work together to comply with all applicable health & safety practices and protocols, including public health orders and regulations that are mandated by local, state, provincial, federal, international authorities, and clients.

About Tetra Tech

Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 30,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science ® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

Tetra Tech is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, marital or familial status, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Tetra Tech is a VEVRAA federal contractor and we request priority referral of veterans.

We invite applications from all interested parties.

Explore our open positions at https://www.tetratech.com/careers Follow us on social media to learn more about our people, culture, and opportunities:

• Participate in strategic meetings and represent the Data team on agency committees and workgroups

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field

• Upward mobility with clear promotional opportunities within the agency across California and Washington

jobs.description:
Lake Superior Consulting is seeking a Project Coordinator to join our growing team!

The Project Coordinator will support the execution of Corrosion Control projects focused on corrosion protection, inspection and testing services, and regulatory compliance initiatives. Typical projects may include Cathodic Protection Design, AC Mitigation Design, and Regulatory/Inspection Services.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys organization, coordination, and supporting technical project teams in a collaborative environment. The Project Coordinator will play a key role in supporting project execution, tracking schedules and costs, and helping ensure projects remain aligned with scope, timelines, and client expectations.

Responsibilities

Support proposal and project setup activities.
Develop and maintain project schedules and staffing plans throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate with Equipment and Procurement teams to secure vehicles, tools, and equipment needed for project execution.
Assist with project cost tracking and reporting activities.
Coordinate with Accounting and Project Managers to gather and maintain accurate project cost information.
Track project schedule and cost performance for use in status reporting.
Maintain consistency in project reporting across service areas.
Support project reporting efforts utilizing Earned Value Management principles.
Assist with project closeout activities and lessons learned documentation.
Support field project kickoffs and collaborate with field teams as needed to better understand project scope, operations, and client needs.
Manage smaller projects from initiation through closeout with support from Project Management leadership, including:
Proposal development
Budget and baseline schedule tracking
Project requirements coordination (operator qualifications, equipment, reporting, etc.)
Client and internal status updates
Invoicing support
Deliverable coordination and project closeout

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education/experience in a related field.
2+ years of experience supporting or executing field-based project work preferred.
Interest in developing project management skills and experience.
Basic understanding of integrity management and/or pipeline-related work scopes preferred.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and MS Project.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Strong organizational and customer service skills.
High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

If you’re driven, curious, and ready to grow your career while making a difference, we want to hear from you.

Lake Superior Consulting offers a competitive compensation package. The actual starting salary will be determined based on a variety of factors, including your skills, experience, and office/market location. The anticipated salary range for this position is $60,000-$75,000 per year.

Tuition reimbursement

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys organization, coordination, and supporting technical project teams in a collaborative environment. The Project Coordinator will play a key role in supporting project execution, tracking schedules and costs, and helping ensure projects remain aligned with scope, timelines, and client expectations.

Responsibilities

Support proposal and project setup activities.
Develop and maintain project schedules and staffing plans throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate with Equipment and Procurement teams to secure vehicles, tools, and equipment needed for project execution.
Assist with project cost tracking and reporting activities.

new_jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Role Description
This role is for a Junior Data Analyst responsible for supporting data-driven decision-making through data collection, analysis, validation, and reporting. In this position, you will assist in transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support business operations, performance monitoring, and strategic initiatives.
As a Junior Data Analyst, you will work with datasets from multiple sources, helping to clean, organize, and prepare data for analysis. You will support senior analysts or cross-functional teams by performing structured analyses, identifying basic trends and patterns, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
Key responsibilities include maintaining datasets, performing data validation checks, and assisting with routine analytical tasks. You will help generate reports, dashboards, and summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You will collaborate with teams across departments to understand data requirements, support reporting needs, and contribute to ongoing analytics projects. This role provides exposure to real-world data workflows, business metrics, and analytical processes, making it ideal for individuals looking to develop foundational data analysis skills.
The Junior Data Analyst role requires strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and a willingness to learn. You will be expected to follow data standards, document assumptions, and ensure that outputs are accurate, timely, and aligned with business objectives.
Clear communication skills are important, as you will assist in explaining data findings and supporting informed decision-making. By providing reliable analytical support, the Junior Data Analyst plays an important role in enabling data-driven insights and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources
Perform basic data analysis to identify trends and patterns
Validate data accuracy and consistency
Maintain and update datasets and data documentation
Assist in creating reports, dashboards, and summaries
Support ad-hoc data requests and routine analytical tasks
Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders on data requirements
Document methodologies, assumptions, and data sources
Support performance tracking and operational reporting
Follow data quality and governance standards

Qualifications
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
High attention to detail and data accuracy
Ability to work with structured datasets
Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic analysis tools
Basic understanding of data analysis concepts and metrics
Ability to create clear reports and summaries
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
Willingness to learn and develop analytical skills
Educational background in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred
